designations.eng: arched chute type totalising weighing instrument

eng: arched chute type totalising weighing instrument

terms.designation: arched chute type totalising weighing instrument

definitions.content: weigher designed such that it causes a vertical flow of bulk product to effect a centripetal force proportionally to the mass of the product passing along the circular arched surface of the force receptor (2.2.1)

notes.content: Not all chute weighers meet the definition stated in this Recommendation.
Arched chute weighers are designed such that a vertical flow of bulk product uses the action of gravity to effect a centripetal force proportional to the mass of the product.
The force receptor of an arched chute weigher is equipped with a circular arched surface.

Arched chute weighers that measure horizontal flows, using only centripetal force, are not covered by the definition of a weighing instrument in 2.1.1 and therefore are not covered by this Recommendation.
